item.name: Get list of all available gas prices

request.name: Get list of all available gas prices

description.content: This endpoint provides real-time information on the current gas prices across all supported blockchain networks. Gas prices play a crucial role in the speed and cost of executing transactions on a blockchain, and fluctuate frequently based on network demand and usage. By using this endpoint, developers can stay up-to-date with the latest gas prices and adjust their application's transaction parameters accordingly to ensure optimal speed and cost efficiency.

query.description: Return only gas prices from specified chains (comma-separated list). You can find available chain ids in chain endpoints.
Return only gas prices with specified gas-type (comma-separated list).

response.name: List of gas prices
